scope: Local evaluation only. No candidate model may be shipped or redistributed from this metadata alone.
selection_policy: Four materially different realtime families with official streaming artifacts were retained. Missing values are null, not inferred.

publication.title: DeepFilterNet3: Towards Real-Time Speech Enhancement on Embedded Devices for Full-Band Audio
publication.relationship: The low-latency artifact is current official upstream material; the publication describes DeepFilterNet3 but does not independently freeze this artifact.

weights.evidence: The model archive is tracked in the licensed repository, but the upstream license text says all code and does not separately identify model-weight terms.

licenses.commercial_use: Source license permits commercial use; weight commercial-use status requires clarification before shipping.
licenses.redistribution: Do not redistribute the model archive until the weight terms are explicitly confirmed.

artifact.format: tar.gz containing split ONNX encoder/ERB decoder/deep-filter decoder and config

signal_contract.declared_algorithmic_latency_source: official libDF formula fft_size - hop_size + lookahead * hop_size
signal_contract.reset_semantics: State, rolling spectra, normalization, and STFT/ISTFT buffers must return to construction state; Auralis verification pending.

runtime.engine: official Rust libDF using tract ONNX
runtime.cpu_simd_requirements: No mandatory SIMD feature found; host-specific measurement required.
runtime.expected_cpu_feasibility: credible, not yet measured by Auralis

deployment.model_availability: artifact bytes are pinned in official Git history
deployment.expected_complexity: medium: Rust runtime is compatible with Auralis but model state and three ONNX graphs require an isolated adapter
deployment.model_download_policy: allowlisted URL, exact size, SHA-256 verification, atomic placement

uncertainties: Weight license is not separately stated.
Exact parameter count and MACs for the low-latency artifact are not stated in the pinned upstream files.
The 480-sample structural delay must be verified with Auralis impulse/alignment controls.

gate_a.reason: Official full-band 48 kHz zero-lookahead model artifact with a reproducible revision and hash; redistribution remains gated.

runtime.cpu_simd_requirements: ONNX Runtime build dependent; Auralis must record enabled CPU features.
runtime.expected_cpu_feasibility: high from model size, but complete 48/16/48 path is not yet measured

deployment.model_availability: artifact bytes are pinned in official Git history
deployment.expected_complexity: medium-high: native runtime plus streaming STFT, cache, rational framing, and bidirectional resampling adapter

The official example performs streaming model inference over an offline STFT; production frontend algorithmic delay is not declared.
The complete 48 kHz round-trip cost and high-frequency loss are unmeasured.

weights.evidence: Official archive contains generated C weight data and two training checkpoints but no separate license file.

licenses.commercial_use: Source license permits commercial use; downloaded model-weight status requires clarification before shipping.
licenses.redistribution: Do not redistribute the model archive until weight terms are explicitly confirmed.

artifact.format: tar.gz containing generated C weights and PyTorch checkpoints

signal_contract.lookahead_source: The current code delays spectra and performs 960-sample analysis/OLA, but does not declare one latency value.
signal_contract.verified_algorithmic_latency_source: Auralis native RNNoise processor measurement; 64-sample drift-resampler delay is recorded separately
signal_contract.reset_semantics: rnnoise_init clears DenoiseState; Auralis reset repeatability verified.

runtime.engine: native C library with embedded/generated weights
runtime.cpu_simd_requirements: portable path exists; x86 runtime may select SIMD implementation

deployment.model_availability: official hash-named archive verified against model_version
deployment.expected_complexity: low runtime complexity, medium build complexity due to C/FFI isolation and generated weights
deployment.model_download_policy: allowlisted URL, exact size, SHA-256 verification, atomic placement

uncertainties: Weight license is not separately stated in the model archive.
Exact current parameter/MAC count is not stated in pinned upstream metadata.
Algorithmic latency must be measured from the current implementation rather than copied from the 2017 paper.

gate_a.reason: Mature 48 kHz fixed-480-sample native control with a cryptographically pinned official model archive; redistribution remains gated.

rejected_at_gate_a.reason: Same family and runtime as the official low-latency variant but with two model-lookahead frames; retained only as an optional within-family ablation, not a fifth family.
An official low-latency artifact now exists at the frozen upstream revision, so third-party conversion provenance is unnecessary.
Auralis requires a useful CPU baseline and no additional primary-source candidate justified displacing one of the four frozen families.
